creative_constitution.primary_film: Long human conversation remains the visual and interaction anchor; system work enters, transforms, condenses, and stays inspectable without becoming a dashboard.
forbidden_shortcuts: one questionnaire renderer with cosmetic skins
one activity accordion repeated eight times
decorative gradients or glow as hierarchy

window_concepts.title: Atlas Folio
window_concepts.design_thesis: Treat Chat as a bound reading leaf inside a working atlas: the transcript is the page, pinned history is a navigable folio gutter, and artifacts are foldout plates that extend left without displacing the reader's place.
window_concepts.conversation_reading_strategy: A centered, book-like measure stays visually dominant while the host provides quiet page furniture and strong top-to-bottom continuity.
window_concepts.secondary_detail_strategy: Controls and operational truth live in page furniture, marginal indexes, and footers that expand only at the point of use.
window_concepts.narrow_width_strategy: The folio gutter becomes a labeled page-edge comb; artifact plates remain outside Chat while the transcript retains a 520 px readable leaf.
window_concepts.motion_thesis: Objects hinge from known seams: history opens from the binding, artifacts unfold from their inline reference, and remounts preserve a page marker rather than a raw pixel offset.
window_concepts.question_strategy: Thread-owned question surfaces receive a stable folio stage with no host-level modal or overlay.
window_concepts.activity_work_strategy: Thread-owned work clusters sit on the reading leaf while host chrome exposes only a calm active-page marker.
window_concepts.history_strategy: Full pinned history is a persistent vertical folio gutter; peek is a temporary page fan; compact pin is a narrow edge index with counts and status words.
window_concepts.artifact_strategy: Artifacts open as left foldout plates connected to their durable shortcut; switching plates preserves the transcript page marker and draft.

window_concepts.title: Stage Bay
window_concepts.design_thesis: Frame Chat as a live stage whose transcript is the performance, with a backstage cue stack for history and a left scene bay for artifacts; supporting systems remain present but off the main sightline until called.
window_concepts.conversation_reading_strategy: A generous proscenium isolates the transcript from shell noise and keeps the composer as the fixed downstage edge.
window_concepts.secondary_detail_strategy: Route, context, and work details appear as cue sheets at the stage perimeter rather than permanent panels.
window_concepts.narrow_width_strategy: The cue stack becomes a single compact runhead above the stage while the artifact bay uses spare host width and never overlays the performance.
window_concepts.motion_thesis: State changes are authored as cues: anticipation, entrance from the correct wing, a brief held focus, then a settle into the transcript or evidence archive.
window_concepts.question_strategy: The host dims only peripheral furniture while the selected thread's question choreography owns the stage and composer relationship.
window_concepts.activity_work_strategy: Active work receives one truthful cue light and the thread composition; completion extinguishes the cue and leaves durable evidence in place.
window_concepts.history_strategy: Pinned history is a vertical backstage cue stack between artifact bay and stage; compact mode becomes a runhead with the active and waiting threads.
window_concepts.artifact_strategy: Artifacts enter the dedicated left scene bay; loading, update, and error are scene states with an unchanged Chat stage.

window_concepts.title: Signal House
window_concepts.design_thesis: Build a precise signal-house workspace where Chat is the dispatch lane, history is a route board, and artifacts occupy a separate instrument table; hierarchy comes from ruled alignment and state words rather than dashboard cards.
window_concepts.conversation_reading_strategy: The transcript is a continuous dispatch record with a strong vertical axis and fixed composer terminus.
window_concepts.secondary_detail_strategy: Details use compact signal records, explicit statuses, and inspectable route sheets instead of decorative indicators.
window_concepts.narrow_width_strategy: The route board rotates into a horizontal track above Chat, with full thread details reached from stable track positions.
window_concepts.motion_thesis: Movement follows visible routes: selectors switch tracks in place, queued work advances station by station, and reconnect replay traverses exactly once to its terminal receipt.
window_concepts.question_strategy: Question priority is represented as a held signal in the host while the thread owns the distinct answer surface.
window_concepts.activity_work_strategy: Host geometry reserves no permanent work panel; current route and server state occupy a compact dispatch line only when material.
window_concepts.history_strategy: Pinned history is a ruled route board with lightweight thread shells; peek is a temporary route strip and compact pin is a horizontal track.
window_concepts.artifact_strategy: Artifacts occupy the left instrument table with explicit load, updated, fault, and retry states; context admission remains a separate action.

window_concepts.title: Lens Chamber
window_concepts.design_thesis: Use concentric focus zones to make Chat feel observed through an instrument rather than placed in a panel: the conversation is the clear aperture, history forms an external perimeter band, and artifacts occupy a calibrated plate to the left.
window_concepts.conversation_reading_strategy: The aperture maintains a calm, high-contrast reading field while peripheral state is progressively defocused through hierarchy, never blur-dependent semantics.
window_concepts.secondary_detail_strategy: Context, provenance, and route truth occupy calibrated rings that disclose inward toward the relevant message or composer control.
window_concepts.narrow_width_strategy: Perimeter bands become stacked calibration bars above and below Chat, preserving full-width prose and reachable details.
window_concepts.motion_thesis: Focus transfers through concentric scale and opacity with stable centers; active objects never orbit or move beneath a pointer, and reduced motion uses immediate ring-state replacement.
window_concepts.question_strategy: The host marks the active question as the current focal plane while the thread supplies its own interaction geometry.
window_concepts.activity_work_strategy: Only the active phase occupies the outer status ring; completed evidence returns to the thread's durable history.
window_concepts.history_strategy: Pinned history forms a persistent perimeter band outside the transcript; full mode exposes two rows, compact mode one calibrated strip, and peek temporarily widens the band.
window_concepts.artifact_strategy: The left calibration plate holds the active artifact and version state without becoming a second browser or changing Context Lens admission.

window_concepts.title: Field Desk
window_concepts.design_thesis: Compose the host as an asymmetrical field desk: artifacts are the large working board on the left, Chat is a protected correspondence column, and history is a physical index drawer that uses horizontal space only when useful.
window_concepts.conversation_reading_strategy: The correspondence column keeps a stable measure and bottom composer while the surrounding desk can reorganize around real work.
window_concepts.secondary_detail_strategy: Operational records appear as clipped-to-purpose sheets on the work board, with direct Open, Watch, Details, and recovery actions.
window_concepts.narrow_width_strategy: The index drawer moves below the transcript as a persistent sibling shelf; the artifact board remains in host space and Chat never becomes a sliver.
window_concepts.motion_thesis: Desk pieces slide along measured axes and settle with weight; artifact handoff travels from message shortcut to board, while drawer changes preserve the correspondence marker.
window_concepts.question_strategy: The host clears incidental desk sheets while retaining the ordinary draft and lets the thread place its question brief.
window_concepts.activity_work_strategy: Work details may coordinate with the artifact board, but the thread remains the owner of activity chronology and completion evidence.
window_concepts.history_strategy: History is a persistent index drawer: a bottom shelf at pressure, a vertical drawer at normal width, and a brief tabbed peek when unpinned.
window_concepts.artifact_strategy: Artifacts command the left working board with multi-file, image, report, and error compositions; Chat remains a separate correspondence region.

window_concepts.title: Tidal Shelf
window_concepts.design_thesis: Shape the workspace as an organic channel with Chat as the steady current, history as a reservoir that can broaden or recede, and artifacts as the left bank; soft geometry serves flow without becoming decorative glass.
window_concepts.conversation_reading_strategy: Messages move down one uninterrupted current with generous breathing intervals and a composer anchored at the river mouth.
window_concepts.secondary_detail_strategy: Secondary systems collect in calm eddies beside the relevant turn and drain into compact receipts after completion.
window_concepts.narrow_width_strategy: The reservoir becomes a shallow right shelf of thread markers, then a top waterline at 520 px; the current keeps its full readable course.
window_concepts.motion_thesis: Content yields and settles like displacement in a shared volume—no bounce, no looping decoration, and no target motion during interaction.
window_concepts.question_strategy: Question preparation gathers into a still pool at the composer boundary before the thread's unique form takes focus and recedes.
window_concepts.activity_work_strategy: Concurrent work occupies separate eddies that join a completed evidence delta without erasing individual histories.
window_concepts.history_strategy: Pinned history is a right-side reservoir of lightweight shells; full, compact, peek, and closed states change real geometry and use spare width first.
window_concepts.artifact_strategy: Artifacts inhabit the left bank with version ripples expressed as labeled state changes, never as perpetual animation.

window_concepts.title: Concourse
window_concepts.design_thesis: Make the host an architectural concourse: Chat is the main passage, pinned history is a mezzanine with lateral overview, and artifacts open in a left hall connected by explicit wayfinding.
window_concepts.conversation_reading_strategy: A long central passage supports uninterrupted reading and reliable return points while shell controls occupy destination markers rather than cards.
window_concepts.secondary_detail_strategy: Search, context, and runtime detail open as wayfinding boards whose origin and return destination remain obvious.
window_concepts.narrow_width_strategy: The mezzanine reduces to a single destination strip with keyboard-scrollable thread stops; the main passage retains minimum width.
window_concepts.motion_thesis: Directional transitions communicate where a surface lives: lateral for thread destinations, leftward for artifacts, vertical for mezzanine history, and in-place replacement for detail.
window_concepts.question_strategy: Questions become the current destination without closing or losing the ordinary composer draft; completion returns focus to the passage.
window_concepts.activity_work_strategy: Active Goal and server work show as concise departure/arrival boards, while full evidence remains in the selected thread.
window_concepts.history_strategy: Pinned history is a horizontal mezzanine above Chat, supporting full and compact rows; peek descends temporarily without covering transcript or composer.
window_concepts.artifact_strategy: The artifact hall opens left of Chat with stable wayfinding back to the source message and owner surface.

window_concepts.title: Quiet Frame
window_concepts.design_thesis: Reduce the host to an exact architectural frame: Chat, history, and artifacts are distinguished by proportion, rules, and typography rather than surfaces, shadows, or ornamental status chrome.
window_concepts.conversation_reading_strategy: The transcript receives the largest uninterrupted measure and the strongest typographic hierarchy; everything else is deliberately quieter.
window_concepts.secondary_detail_strategy: Details appear as aligned textual registers with clear action verbs and semantic rules, avoiding chips and container nesting.
window_concepts.narrow_width_strategy: The measurement gutter compresses into a single textual index line; secondary registers stack above Chat without hiding functionality.
window_concepts.motion_thesis: Motion is restrained and exact: short translations prove origin, in-place replacements preserve geometry, and completion removes visual weight instead of celebrating.
window_concepts.question_strategy: The host contributes no special card; the thread's question language occupies the existing frame and returns it unchanged.
window_concepts.activity_work_strategy: One quiet run-state register appears only while needed; completed details belong to the transcript composition.
window_concepts.history_strategy: Pinned history is a precise right measurement gutter with full and compact typographic registers; peek temporarily widens the gutter without overlay.
window_concepts.artifact_strategy: The artifact region is a borderless left field separated by a single rule, with explicit title, version, status, and owner actions.

thread_concepts.title: Edition
thread_concepts.design_thesis: Design the conversation as a carefully edited long-form publication: assistant prose is the main text, user turns are emphatic pull passages, and system evidence behaves like scholarly apparatus rather than application cards.
thread_concepts.conversation_reading_strategy: A serif-led primary column uses chapter rhythm, controlled measure, drop-scale openings, and clearly separated message action siblings.
thread_concepts.secondary_detail_strategy: Metadata, provenance, and work appear as numbered notes and marginal references tied to exact turns.
thread_concepts.narrow_width_strategy: Margins fold beneath their passages as endnotes while action rows remain reachable and prose keeps a readable measure.
thread_concepts.motion_thesis: New messages typeset into their final place from the composer baseline; notes collect and condense with page-marker continuity rather than generic fades.
thread_concepts.question_strategy: A question becomes a facing-page chapter with a persistent answer index, reviewable leaves, reversible Skip, explicit Cancel questionnaire, and a durable submitted colophon.
thread_concepts.activity_strategy: Goal, Todo, agents, tools, diffs, and tests are independent numbered work notes; active notes update in place and completed notes become a reopenable references section.
thread_concepts.history_strategy: Thread history state is represented by chapter markers and branch colophons inside the transcript while the selected window owns pinned history geometry.
thread_concepts.artifact_relationship: Artifacts appear as figure citations and open on the window's left plate without entering context automatically.

thread_concepts.title: Dialogue Score
thread_concepts.design_thesis: Compose conversation as a performance score: user and assistant occupy distinct full-width voices, while activity, agents, and evidence form synchronized staves between spoken passages.
thread_concepts.conversation_reading_strategy: Speaker roles are established by typography, cadence, and horizontal phrasing rather than opposing bubbles.
thread_concepts.secondary_detail_strategy: Timing, route, and provenance sit in a compact score key; details expand as labeled measures without moving primary controls.
thread_concepts.narrow_width_strategy: Parallel staves serialize into a single score while retaining speaker marks and phase alignment.
thread_concepts.motion_thesis: Events enter on a shared beat, hand off between stable lanes, and resolve into a held final measure; reduced motion advances the score marker without spatial travel.
thread_concepts.question_strategy: Questions occupy a fixed measure with choices arranged as beats; previous answers remain visible in the score key and navigation never relocates during replacement.
thread_concepts.activity_strategy: Each work domain owns a stave with its own expansion state; concurrent child work aligns in time without being flattened into one accordion.
thread_concepts.history_strategy: Restore points and branches are repeat signs and alternate endings with plain-language labels and direct actions.
thread_concepts.artifact_relationship: Artifact handoff is a scored coda with a stable identity and an explicit route to the host's left workspace.

thread_concepts.title: Timefield
thread_concepts.design_thesis: Make elapsed human and system time legible without turning Chat into telemetry: each turn occupies a measured temporal field, with pauses, waiting, activity, and completion placed along a calm chronological axis.
thread_concepts.conversation_reading_strategy: Long prose remains in conventional reading blocks while an adjacent time field explains worked versus elapsed duration and wait reasons.
thread_concepts.secondary_detail_strategy: Metadata expands along the relevant interval; compact state words replace raw timestamps until More Info is requested.
thread_concepts.narrow_width_strategy: The time field becomes a horizontal runhead above each message so prose keeps the full column.
thread_concepts.motion_thesis: Activity advances through time bands with coalesced updates; pauses hold position, redirects split the interval, and completion contracts into a durable temporal summary.
thread_concepts.question_strategy: A questionnaire is a sequence of anchored waypoints with stable progress, visible prior answers, and a submission receipt at the terminal time marker.
thread_concepts.activity_strategy: Goal phases, Todos, agents, tools, diffs, and verification occupy independent temporal bands that can reopen without shifting the selected message anchor.
thread_concepts.history_strategy: Branch, rewind, and restore produce dated waypoints with immutable source links, not a fake workspace rollback.
thread_concepts.artifact_relationship: Artifacts are time-stamped outputs with loading, updated, and retry intervals that open in the host workspace.

thread_concepts.title: Branchbook
thread_concepts.design_thesis: Center the conversation's ability to revise without erasure: turns are readable leaves joined by explicit ancestry, while redirect, rewind, restore, and sibling answers reveal alternatives without fragmenting the primary narrative.
thread_concepts.conversation_reading_strategy: The active branch reads as one continuous book; ancestry and alternates remain compact at fold points until requested.
thread_concepts.secondary_detail_strategy: Route, Persona, context, and revision differences are shown at branch joints with concise evidence and clear source preservation.
thread_concepts.narrow_width_strategy: Branch maps collapse to a vertical ancestry spine with labeled sibling counts; the active prose leaf remains full width.
thread_concepts.motion_thesis: A branch grows from its exact source joint, redirect preserves the interrupted leaf, and restore moves focus along ancestry without pretending files rolled back.
thread_concepts.question_strategy: Question answers form reversible fork leaves; re-answering creates a sibling answer leaf while the original questionnaire receipt remains immutable.
thread_concepts.activity_strategy: Work is grouped into revision layers—attempt, interruption, recovery, replacement, verification—each independently inspectable and never overwritten.
thread_concepts.history_strategy: Restore points, sibling branches, and active ancestry are first-class inline folds coordinated with the window's project history.
thread_concepts.artifact_relationship: Artifacts retain branch and version lineage and open left with the exact originating leaf selected.

thread_concepts.title: Workshop
thread_concepts.design_thesis: Treat the transcript as a working studio journal where conversation leads and material operations appear as purposeful instruments placed between turns, not as a universal activity card.
thread_concepts.conversation_reading_strategy: Human dialogue uses generous journal entries separated by workbench intervals that never interrupt sentence-level reading.
thread_concepts.secondary_detail_strategy: Operational detail is organized by the object being changed—file, test, browser session, worktree, port, artifact—rather than by generic event type.
thread_concepts.narrow_width_strategy: The workbench becomes a stack of labeled drawers with 44 px targets, while prose stays unboxed and full width.
thread_concepts.motion_thesis: Tools enter from the object they affect, active drawers change in place, and completion returns instruments to a compact inventory while leaving outputs on the bench.
thread_concepts.question_strategy: Questions are pinned workshop briefs with a stable brief header, varied input surfaces, an answer checklist, and clear prepare/submit states.
thread_concepts.activity_strategy: Goal, Todo, Crew, tools, tests, diffs, and artifacts use different instrument drawers that can remain open simultaneously and condense into an inventory ledger.
thread_concepts.history_strategy: Branches and restore points appear as journal edition stamps tied to exact workbench states.
thread_concepts.artifact_relationship: Artifacts are finished or in-progress bench objects with direct Open left, Reveal, retry, version, and lineage actions.

thread_concepts.title: Braided
thread_concepts.design_thesis: Represent conversation, delegated work, and evidence as separate strands that cross at meaningful handoffs while keeping the human dialogue visually strongest.
thread_concepts.conversation_reading_strategy: User and assistant strands alternate around a central reading axis; long prose temporarily claims the full measure.
thread_concepts.secondary_detail_strategy: Context, provenance, route, and receipts attach as short knots at the turn or handoff that produced them.
thread_concepts.narrow_width_strategy: The braid serializes into one column with persistent strand labels and connection marks; no information relies on side-by-side width.
thread_concepts.motion_thesis: Work strands split from the parent request, progress independently, and rejoin at synthesis; target positions stay fixed during interaction and reduced motion uses labeled connection changes.
thread_concepts.question_strategy: A question flow is woven through a stable central path; answered, skipped, and pending strands remain reviewable before the submission knot closes them.
thread_concepts.activity_strategy: Goal, Todo, subagent, Crew, tool, test, and diff strands retain independent states and join only through explicit parent synthesis.
thread_concepts.history_strategy: Thread requests and branch ancestry are visible strand continuations with bounded passage-add actions rather than hidden transcript copying.
thread_concepts.artifact_relationship: Artifacts detach as labeled output strands and open in the host workspace while retaining source and derived lineage.

thread_concepts.title: Relay
thread_concepts.design_thesis: Make coordination understandable as a sequence of accountable handoffs: the parent conversation is the course, agents and other threads occupy relay zones, and capacity, waiting, fallback, and synthesis stay truthful.
thread_concepts.conversation_reading_strategy: Primary prose follows one strong course; delegated passages enter as compact handoff records at the exact point they were requested or returned.
thread_concepts.secondary_detail_strategy: Provider route, budget, scope, lineage, idempotency, and capacity live in expandable baton receipts with human labels.
thread_concepts.narrow_width_strategy: Parallel relay lanes become a numbered handoff stack, preserving order, ownership, and status without compressing prose.
thread_concepts.motion_thesis: Requests travel from parent to child, queued members hold at a visible gate, results return to synthesis, and failed handoffs retain their position before fallback.
thread_concepts.question_strategy: Questions are checkpoint gates owned by the parent: child waiting state, user answer, return receipt, and resumed work stay causally linked.
thread_concepts.activity_strategy: Crew roles, waves, sustainable capacity, thread requests, agent work, and parent synthesis form distinct relay zones rather than one agent list.
thread_concepts.history_strategy: Await, resume, spawn, and branch actions retain source/target links and expose Open conversation, Add passage, Branch, and Copy link.
thread_concepts.artifact_relationship: Artifacts are finish-line deliverables with producer, branch, test, and synthesis receipts before opening left.

thread_concepts.title: Quiet Current
thread_concepts.design_thesis: Pursue radical calm for very long conversations: one uninterrupted typographic current carries dialogue, while all system work compresses into precise runlines that expand only when the reader asks.
thread_concepts.conversation_reading_strategy: A single-column, borderless stream uses spacing, indentation, and type weight to distinguish roles and support sustained reading.
thread_concepts.secondary_detail_strategy: Metadata and provenance are terse inline runlines; More Info opens a plain aligned register without cards or badges.
thread_concepts.narrow_width_strategy: The same one-column grammar survives unchanged at 520 px, with secondary actions wrapping into deliberate rows and no hidden core behavior.
thread_concepts.motion_thesis: Motion nearly disappears: send settles through one short translation, activity text replaces in place, and completion reduces density; causality is carried by stable identity and precise wording.
thread_concepts.question_strategy: The current pauses at a borderless focus sheet above the composer; question content replaces atomically, prior answers form a quiet review line, and the ordinary draft returns intact.
thread_concepts.activity_strategy: One live runline names the current phase while independent detail registers preserve Goal, Todo, agents, tools, diffs, tests, and evidence; completion becomes a calm domain index.
thread_concepts.history_strategy: Branch and restore appear as understated current breaks with immutable source links and no decorative tree.
thread_concepts.artifact_relationship: Artifacts surface as plain-text handoff lines with state, version, and Open left action; the host supplies the workspace.
